rationale: C03 is a highly plausible drafting template. It addresses the same transportation-policy problem, assigns the Secretary of Commerce leadership, calls for recommendations to the President, provides for participation by other relevant Federal officials, and imposes a specific deadline. The child compresses and adapts that machinery: instead of establishing a Cabinet committee, it places primary responsibility in Commerce and requires cooperation from all other transportation agencies, while shifting the requested output toward recommendations for the next session of Congress. C19 and C02 share substantial study-and-recommendation machinery, but concern different policy fields and lack C03's unusually close match in subject, lead department, purpose, and operative sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the current difficulties facing all segments of the transportation industry will require increased leadership and additional actions on the part of the Federal Government
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Government must provide effective leadership in assuring that its policies and programs affecting the various forms of transportation... are best designed to aid them
shared_material.explanation: Both open from the need for stronger Federal leadership across the transportation sector.

shared_material.child_excerpt: take the lead in developing for my consideration recommendations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am requesting you to serve as Chairman of this Cabinet Committee... whose task will be the presentation of recommendations for my consideration
shared_material.explanation: Both charge the Commerce Secretary with leading a coordinated process that produces recommendations for presidential consideration.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Since the Department of Commerce has the statutory authority for the development of a national transportation policy, I am placing the primary responsibility for this task in the Department.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Because of your major responsibilities in the field of transportation, I am requesting you to serve as Chairman
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts the same allocation of transportation-policy leadership to Commerce, replacing committee chairmanship with departmental primary responsibility.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Under your direction, I will expect full cooperation and participation of all other Federal agencies with functions and interests in the transportation area.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: By copies of this letter, I am designating the Secretary of Defense and the Director of the Office of Defense Mobilization to serve as the other members... [other officials] will participate on an ad hoc basis.
shared_material.explanation: Both establish an interagency process under the Commerce Secretary's leadership; the child generalizes the enumerated membership into all interested Federal agencies.

shared_material.child_excerpt: have your recommendations in my hands by November 1, 1961
shared_material.parent_excerpt: submit its recommendations to me not later than December 1, 1954
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude with a fixed deadline for submission of recommendations to the President.
